items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you -- do you remember Barney Josephson, who was the owner of the club? [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, I remember him, yes.

ctx.x: Because when I was talking to Barney Josephson about it, he was saying that the reason he opened the club was that all of the clubs that he went to, other than like certain kinds of after-hours spots, --
